name: Song of the Strider
summary: Neza Bloodsnout finds signs of a great lion near Rog'mar and offers to help draw it out. You bring her a tallstrider beak so she can shape a hunting whistle.

sections.title: A Hunter's Whistle
sections.body: At Rog'mar, Neza Bloodsnout reads the marks as those of a lion, likely the leader of a nearby pride. She offers you first claim on the hunt and will help draw the beast out. For that, she needs a tallstrider beak to shape a whistle that sounds like a wounded tallstrider.

faq.answer: Neza Bloodsnout is a hunter at Rog'mar who can make whistles and animal calls.

faq.q: What does Neza think made the markings?
faq.answer: Neza thinks the markings came from a lion, likely the leader of a nearby pride.

faq.q: Why does Neza need a tallstrider beak?
faq.answer: Neza needs a tallstrider beak to shape a whistle that mimics a wounded tallstrider's call.
The whistle is meant to lure the lion out by sounding like a wounded tallstrider.

faq.q: Where does Neza ask you to bring the beak?
faq.answer: Bring the intact tallstrider beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

attribution: In-game quest text: Song of the Strider
